lanes.title: Lanes and responsibilities
lanes.description: Who carries this lane? Name and order come from the BPMN model and are refreshed whenever a version is saved. Role, org unit, vendor and third country are not in the model — they are maintained here and carry the trust boundary in the diagram.
lanes.empty: No lanes are recorded for this process. They appear on import or when a BPMN version containing lanes or pools is saved.
lanes.notInDiagramHint: This lane is no longer in the current BPMN version. It was not deleted on save because it carries an assignment.
lanes.diagramUnknown: The current BPMN version could not be read, so whether a lane is still in the diagram is not shown.
lanes.externalLabel: Lane is operated outside our own organisation
lanes.thirdCountryHelp: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two capital letters. Only together with “External”.
lanes.vendorsTruncated: More than {limit} vendors — please search to narrow the list.
lanes.deleteConfirm: This lane is no longer in the diagram. Remove it permanently?

sod.title: Segregation-of-duties rules
sod.description: Two roles the same person must not hold at once. The rules apply organisation-wide and colour the “segregation of duties” view in the diagram. They are in no BPMN model and in no event log — only here.
sod.empty: No rules recorded yet. Without rules the “segregation of duties” view stays empty.
sod.selfPairHint: The same role for A and B is allowed and describes the most common violation: one role owns both tasks.
sod.rationalePlaceholder: Why are these two tasks incompatible?
sod.activeHint: A suspended rule stays on record for traceability but no longer raises a conflict in the diagram.
sod.duplicate: A rule for this role pair already exists.
sod.noRoles: No roles exist in this organisation. Without roles no rule can be stated.

raci.title: RACI per step
raci.description: Who is responsible, accountable, consulted, informed? Consulted (C) and informed (I) have no home in the data model outside this screen.
raci.empty: No steps are recorded for this process.
raci.duplicate: This role already carries this letter on this step.
raci.noRoles: No roles exist in this organisation.

bia.title: Continuity figures per step
bia.description: MTPD, RTO and RPO at element level, in minutes. The tearing point of the process is the minimum across all steps — without per-step figures there is nothing to minimise.
bia.empty: No steps are recorded for this process.
bia.processMtpd: Tearing point of the process: {minutes} minutes
bia.processMtpdUnknown: Tearing point of the process: not determinable yet
bia.mtpdHelp: Maximum tolerable period of disruption, in minutes.
bia.rpoHelp: Maximum tolerable data loss, in minutes.
bia.workaroundPlaceholder: How is the step handled without its usual support?
bia.workaroundZeroHint: 0 is a statement: the workaround does not hold. Leaving it empty means “not assessed”.
